sources.title: Nile University’s IECC Concludes Faculty Track Entrepreneurship Program, Showcasing Groundbreaking Startups from Academic Research — Nile University’s IECC Concludes Faculty Track Entrepreneurship Program, Showcasing Groundbreaking Startups from Academic Research - IECC
sources.text:
Nile University’s IECC Concludes Faculty Track Entrepreneurship Program, Showcasing Groundbreaking Startups from Academic Research
Nile University’s Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Competitiveness Centre (IECC) wraps up its 10-week
Entrepreneurship Program – Faculty Track
, empowering faculty to convert cutting-edge research into viable startups.
Four innovative ventures emerged, spanning advanced materials, AI education, bio-inspired tech, and sustainable construction, pitched to a distinguished panel last week.
The program highlights strategies for “research commercialization” (tech transfer and IP protection), “skill bridging” (entrepreneurial training), and “impact scaling” (market validation and funding pathways), aligning with Egypt’s national innovation agenda.
Nile University today
